hints.title: Arbitrary Starting Node
hints.text: The input node can be located anywhere within the doubly linked list, including the middle or tail.

hints.title: Backtracking to Head
hints.text: Traverse backwards using node.prev until reaching the true head whose prev pointer is null.

hints.title: Forward Linear Collection
hints.text: From head, traverse forwards via node.next, collecting each node.val into a list until reaching the tail.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in the doubly linked list
complexity.notes: At most two linear passes (backward to head, then forward to tail).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Only traversing forward from the given node misses all earlier elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space excluding the returned output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes the need to rewind to the head before iterating forwards.
